body: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman object to tokenized stocks traded on OKXICE venue

sourceReview.reason: The scanner headline misstates the October 15 OKXICE issuer-objection event: the current official notice and corroborating coverage identify nine objectors, not Microsoft, Alphabet or Goldman Sachs. The same nine-issuer event is already covered by the existing verified October 15 RWA Wire article, and no new objection or material expansion is evidenced.
